svg.title: OmniRet multimodal retrieval systems and audio-centric multimodal evaluation suite
svg.desc: Full native SVG reconstruction. Base frames: top systems panel, bottom evaluation-suite panel, encoder/database/module boxes, and four task frames. Inventory top panel: query/target modality icon stacks, two dashed separators, blue multimodal retrieval encoder, green OmniRet encoder, query-embedding arrows to a shared vector database cylinder, target-side retrieval arrows, efficiency/high-fidelity pooling modules, captions. Inventory bottom panel: four task frames with icon compositions and directional arrows. Symmetry/equipartition: top panel is horizontally split by dashed rule into baseline and OmniRet rows with target/query stacks mirrored left/right around shared database; bottom panel is split into two columns and two rows of task frames. SAM mapping used only for confirmed individual modality icons and magnifier: P001-P038 correspond to listed asset_sam_region IDs and replace draft_P001-draft_P038 after complete SVG construction; frames, text, borders, arrows, braces, plus signs, and separators are retained.

g.text: (a) Multimodal Retrieval Systems (top) and our OmniRet (bottom)
(b) Our evaluation suite with new Audio-Centric MultiModal tasks.
